Terms & Conditions

Last updated: August 20, 2026

Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions Cookie Policy

1. Acceptance of Terms

By using this website, submitting an inquiry, or staying at Little Survivor Beach Resort (“the Resort”), you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or the Resort’s services.

2. Bookings, Rates & Payment

  1. Rates displayed on the website are in Philippine Pesos (₱) and are subject to change without prior notice.
  2. A booking is confirmed only when the Resort confirms availability and, where required, payment has been received.
  3. Day trip and overnight rates are quoted per accommodation unit. Activity rates (such as ATV, banana boat, and dragon boat) are charged separately.
  4. Payment is accepted via the methods announced by the Resort. Please contact us for current payment options.

3. Check-In & Check-Out

  1. Check-in is from 2:00 PM onwards; check-out is until 12:00 NN (noon).
  2. Early check-in and late check-out may be available on request, subject to availability and prior arrangement.
  3. A valid ID is required for check-in. The Resort reserves the right to refuse entry to anyone who is disorderly or fails to comply with house rules.

4. Cancellation & Rescheduling

Please contact us directly for cancellation or rescheduling arrangements. We understand that plans change and handle each situation with flexibility, but fees may apply for late cancellations or no-shows depending on the booking.

5. Guest Conduct

  1. Guests are responsible for their belongings. The Resort is not liable for lost, damaged, or stolen items.
  2. Please respect the property, other guests, and the environment. Excessive noise after quiet hours is not permitted.
  3. Guests who cause damage to Resort property will be charged for repair or replacement.
  4. Open flames, smoking inside accommodation units, and illegal activity are strictly prohibited.

6. Activities & Safety

  1. Water and beach activities are undertaken at your own risk.
  2. Life jackets must be worn for boat and water activities, and children must be supervised by an adult at all times.
  3. The Resort may cancel or modify activities due to weather, safety conditions, or operational needs, and will not be liable for resulting inconvenience.
  4. Follow the instructions of Resort staff during all activities.

7. Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the Resort, its owners, and staff shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the website, the Resort, or its services — including injuries sustained during beach or water activities, natural occurrences, or events beyond our reasonable control.

8. Website Content

  1. All content on this website — text, photographs, logos, and design — is the property of the Resort unless otherwise stated.
  2. Rates, availability, amenities, and descriptions may change. Images are for representation and may not exactly reflect current conditions.
  3. You may not copy, reproduce, or reuse website content without our written permission.

9. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines. Any dispute shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Zambales, Philippines.
